scope: Resolve availability wording in PLAN sections8and9 without changing any pass criterion or cap.
rules: Every correctness observation comparison retains both current outputs/errors and exact current inputs when available; available evidence must not be discarded.
Direct comparison and lifetime fixtures must update exact-current input/output capture before their first assertion. Last durable checkpoint is always labeled separately.
An alias mismatch must retain the differing relationship, not only a null/null value pair and a path.

A later benchmark-only mismatch cannot access the prior complete baseline pass graph, because successful complete output histories are not retained. Preserve the prior component digest, exact frozen source/input selector, current offending component and any available alias counterexample. Explicitly label absent baseline output.
Any benchmark mismatch is a terminal failure, contributes no passing ratio, and triggers no automatic baseline rerun. A future reproduction requires a separately planned window.
No failure record may silently truncate available evidence or promote a failed/incomplete check. A retention overflow is a disclosed resource/evidence failure.
